headline: Türkiye Lowers Electricity Subsidy Threshold to 3,000 kWh for 2027
summary: Türkiye will lower the annual household electricity consumption threshold to qualify for subsidized national tariffs to 3,000 kilowatt-hours starting in 2027.
why: Energy tariff adjustments in Türkiye directly influence household cost of living, inflation expectations, and utility provider cash flows.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Lowering the subsidized electricity limit shifts utility costs onto a larger segment of households.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
